text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — still seeing missing spans in trace-aggregation for a small % of requests. I added action items to the postmortem doc (https://redwood.docs/pm/901). Need clear owners + ETA so we can schedule a backfill and monitoring.
incident-bot: Auto-created ticket PM-901 on the remediation board and linked to the postmortem.
devon: I can own the ETL consumer fix (likely late offset commit on rollup consumer). ETA: 3 business days for patch + canary.
tess: @devon I will own validation and the test harness. I'll add a synthetic trace generator and unit + integration checks.
oliver: I'll take aggregation config + thresholds, add me to the PR for review. Also proposing an alert when aggregation delta > 0.5% over 5m.
luis: Quick question — do we plan a backfill? Who will run it and what's the expected window?
devon: Yes — small backfill (~6h of events). I'll write a safe backfill script and request an infra window. Will coordinate with @sre-oncall for a low-traffic slot.
sre-oncall: Tentative maintenance window added: Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC. I'll be online to supervise and help rollback if needed.
maria: Please update the postmortem doc owners + ETA by EOD. Also add a short runbook section: detection, runback, rollback, post-checks.
devon: Updated the doc and opened PR: https://git.redwood/repo/etl/merge/123 — canary deployed, traces look healthy and error rate dropped in canary.
tess: Test harness repo: https://git.redwood/repo/trace-tests — running cross-prod samples now, will paste results here when done.
oliver: Monitoring alert created (aggregation-drift-high). Added a short playbook snippet: check consumer lag -> verify commit offsets -> run partial backfill -> monitor p95 latency.
maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-up check-in scheduled Tue 10:00 PT to verify backfill + metric regressions. Owners recap: devon (fix + backfill), tess (validation + tests), oliver (aggregation + monitoring), @sre-oncall (maintenance window). :thumbsup:
